summary: Central TokenShop system unit for extracted row data, token-bank behavior, Daily Tokenium seams, and permanent spend-side boundary/support structure.

rows.summary: ATU row identity, shell, and row-remap grounding plus DB-derived verified row records and explicit heuristic tier-unlock policy.

token-bank.summary: Token-bank ownership, state, controller, and formula boundary surfaces.

daily-tokenium.summary: Daily Tokenium lane naming, action, and ownership clues.

provenance.policy: Copy TokenShop rows, token-bank evidence, and Daily Tokenium evidence into centralized TokenShop views while preserving the committed source file or transient regeneration command for each embedded slice.
provenance.transientProbePolicy: Historical TokenShop probes should not remain live dependencies; when their evidence is copied forward, keep the regeneration command or DB-backed target-bundle identity instead of a permanent pointer to an old report shape.

archiveReview.reason: Grounded TokenShop row and numeric fields now materialize directly from the DB-backed raw metadata plus level0 extract path instead of staying a live committed support input.
This file no longer owns live verified TokenShop records. It remains only as the explicit heuristic tier-unlock policy source until the DB/trace layer recovers stronger threshold evidence.

The old standalone TokenShop cost-lane probe has been replaced by the DB-derived cost-lane projection embedded in data/system-units/token-shop.v1.json, generated from token-shop-family-structure trace materialization plus grounded TokenShop values.

The old standalone spend-action probe has been replaced by the derived TokenShop action-lane projection embedded in data/system-units/token-shop.v1.json, regenerated from grounded TokenShop values, Daily Tokenium clues, and direct metadata/level0 checks.

The old token-bank controller-shell probe has been replaced by the derived controller projection embedded in data/system-units/token-shop.v1.json, regenerated from grounded TokenShop controller fields, token-bank state clues, and direct metadata/level0 checks.

The old TokenShop owner-shell probe has been replaced by the derived owner projection embedded in data/system-units/token-shop.v1.json, regenerated from grounded TokenShop controller fields, token-bank state clues, and direct metadata/level0 checks.

The old Tokenium naming support file has been replaced by the derived naming projection embedded in data/system-units/token-shop.v1.json, regenerated from direct asset-name presence plus metadata and level0 checks.

The old token-bank state support file has been replaced by the derived token-bank state projection embedded in data/system-units/token-shop.v1.json, regenerated from typed metadata support, direct metadata checks, and the grounded token-bank formula boundary.

The old Daily Tokenium lane support file has been replaced by the derived lane projection embedded in data/system-units/token-shop.v1.json, regenerated from typed metadata support plus current metadata and asset-name checks.
This remains the distinct raw SaveData ATU owner boundary and is not yet superseded by the row-remap or trace-backed TokenShop views.
This is now a historical raw keyword/export artifact only; active TokenShop semantics already survive in committed boundaries, trace-backed views, and canonical support datasets.
The remaining typed extractor/debug need is reduced into data/uabea-type-metadata-support.v1.json, so the full raw report should stay historical-only rather than an active TokenShop surface.

requirementsBeforeArchive: App spend summaries must resolve from the centralized TokenShop unit or explicit projections of it.
Trace must keep citing grounded boundaries without depending on exported trace-run reports as primary runtime state.
Any transient TokenShop evidence folded into the centralized unit must carry the command used to regenerate it.
